notes.scope: Neutrino mass-mechanism candidate registry (audit; conditional closures). External bounds are not used as CAP objectives unless explicitly declared; they are used as feasibility filters and as audit channels.

mechanisms.name: Ghost repair-cost accumulation
mechanisms.description: Bridge: convert the ghost-sector mean repair cost c(w) into a suppression exponent K ~ a*m_dec*mean_c_ghost(m_dec).

mechanisms.name: Visibility/temperature ratio xi as shared suppression source
mechanisms.description: Bridge: treat xi as an internal candidate (xi=phi^{-xi_depth}); DeltaNeff is derived as n_R*xi^4 and used only as an external feasibility/audit filter. Map xi to mass depth via r0≈round(p*log_phi(xi)).

mechanisms.name: Refinement dilution under uplift
mechanisms.description: Bridge: dilute a neutral base depth by the lift multiplicity |Ext_m(u)| via r0 = r_base(u) - round(a*log_phi |Ext_m(u)|).

mechanisms.name: Parity-mismatch overhead (unbalanced coupling proxy)
mechanisms.description: Bridge: treat odd-m intermediates m=2n+1 as carrying an overhead count K=a*n that suppresses the absolute scale.

selection.cap_key: lexicographic(minimize complexity, then tie-break by parameter tuple ordering)
